translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Tolula ibodi bikikilaisi titoulesi
E Guyau ikaraiwogi Mosese biluki Eroni dalela mabudona tolula kawala, “Gala taitala yokomi tolula ibodi biyogwali titoulela metoya bivagi avai vavagi avai tuta taitala vaiyola bikaliga,
mesinaku wala inala, kaina tamala, luleta, tuwala, budala,
kaina luleta minana nakubukwabuya eiuvauli.
Matauna gala ibodi biyogwali titoulela metoya osi kaliga la veivai.
“Gala taitala tolula ibodi biviliu katupotala pwanetala kaina bitabuboti kala gabula, kaina bitaguligweili wowola paila biyomitali la ninamwau.
Matauna ibodi bikabomi titoulela e gala biyomsilaigu. Paila matauna igibugabu kaula lulela baisa yeigu, mapaila matauna ibodi bikabomi titoulela.
Tolula gala ibodi bivaiya natana minasina nakalimwala kaina minana bogwa ikikapugula kaina minana nauvaipaka, paila matauna tobumaboma.
E tomota ibodi bivigakaisi tolula tobumaboma, paila matauna igibugabu kaula lulela baisa yeigu. Yeigu goli Guyau. Yeigu Tobumaboma e ulo touwata bavigaki mina bumaboma wala.
Kidamwa taitala tolula latula vivila bivigaki titoulela nakalimwala, minana bogwa eiyomsili tamala, mapaila ibodi wala bigabwaisi minana wa kova bikaliga.

“E Tolula Toveka bogwa eivaputumaisi deli bogwa eikabomaisi matauna paila bisikam kasi karekwa tolula, mapaila matauna gala ibodi biviriviri kulula kaina bikisi kala kwama paila biyomitali la ninamwau.

Paila matauna bogwa leikabomaisi paila yeigu, e gala biyogwali titoulela kaina biyogwali ulo Buliyoyova kwebumaboma metoya bisilavi ulo Buliyoyova e bilaga bwala makwaina tomata eikikanaki, ilagoli tamala kaina inala tatoula.
Matauna ibodi wala bivaiya natana gala ikikapugula,
gala kwabuya kaina natana nauvaipaka kaina natana nakalimwala. Matauna ibodi bivaiya natana gala ikikapugula metoya odalela titoulela.
Mitaga kidamwa gala bivagi makawala, e mwada litula tobumaboma, bogwa bivigaki topupagatu. Yeigu goli Guyau e yeigu bogwa lakatupali matauna lavigaki Tolula Toveka.”
E Guyau ikaraiwogi Mosese
biluki Eroni kawala, “Gala taitala metoya odalem matauna isim pikolela wowola ibodi bigabu kaula lulela baisa yeigu. Karaiwaga makwaina paila tuta baisa deli tubwa tuta oluvi.
Gala taitala isim kala kapwaila ibodi bigabu lula makwaina. gala taitala, tokwau, topem, kaina tobelu kaina tosiekupuna;
gala taitala tobali, kaina togei,
gala taitala tokubula, kaina taitala saina wala tokukupi sainela; gala taitala avai katoula omatala kaina owowola; kaina taitala bogwa eikivaisi kikiyatula.
Gala taitala odalela Eroni Tolula isim kala golia ibodi bigabu kaula lulela baisa yeigu.
Kidamwa taitala bikoma kaula baisa eivigakaisi lula baisa yeigu, kaula lulela kwebumaboma, deli kaula lulela makwaina saina kwebumaboma,

mitaga matauna isim kala golia, matauna gala ibodi bima katitaikinela taboda miyana yabumaboma kaina bivalapula okabogwabu lula. Matauna gala ibodi biyogwali vavagi makwaisina kwebumaboma paila yeigu goli Guyau e lavigaki makwaisina kwebumaboma.”
Baisa makawala avaka Mosese eiluki Eroni, deli litula, deli goli komwaidosi mina Isireli.
